method: Each of the 11 complete page PNGs opened individually with view_image(detail=original); no thumbnail-only or text-only acceptance.

pages.observations: Discussion, revised conclusion and data/code sections are legible; headings and paragraphs have intact spacing, no clipping or footer collision.
References 1–23 are fully visible with aligned hanging indents and readable italic journal titles; no cropped lines.
References 24–28 complete the bibliography; KRAS primary citation 28 and DOI are readable. Retained whitespace before the supplementary-material section is unobstructed.
Supplement A and Table S1 are intact. Native table top/header/bottom rules are clean; counts and Hchi notation are readable.
All six panels of Figure S1, legends, heatmap labels and full caption fit the page. Figure text is English and no panel or axis is clipped.
Supplement B, Tables S2 and S3, and following explanatory text fit together cleanly. Both native three-line tables remain legible.
Supplement C/Table S4 use clean three-line formatting. All methods, MAE/correlation columns and following source comparisons are visible.
Supplement D/Table S5 have clear column spacing and native top/header/bottom rules; all eight rows fit without splitting or clipping.
Dense Supplement E page contains complete Tables S6/S7, captions and continuation prose. Text and symbols remain readable, with no overlap or content outside margins.
Supplement F/Table S8 retain all four KIX states and explanatory paragraph; three-line rules and unit/percent notation are clean.
Supplement G/Table S9 and its caption are fully visible; combination labels and all numerical columns have intact spacing, no overflow.
